Resolves #19597

Since #19559, every header-action pop-out has opened at the 480×360 fallback instead of the footprint of the pane it leaves. The vessel's size now comes from `sourceRect` alone, while the header action passed its measured pane box only as `proxyRect`. `HeaderActions#handleDockPopOutAction` now passes that one measurement as both: `proxyRect` places the vessel and `sourceRect` sizes it. The drag path keeps its own measurement from drag arming.

Evidence: L1 (unit) + L2 (browser e2e, headless) → L2 required (a window size). Residual: none.

Intake: self-authored ticket, filed this session; the prescription is the one-argument change at the admitting call.

| AC-1 | done | All four cases pass at `7076eff422` (local, `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set): `WorkstationNL` › "pop-out uses the Group cursor…", `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL` › "…born at the OUTER size of the tabs node it left", and both `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` resize cases. Bisected: green at `5ccdb192d6^`, red from `5ccdb192d6` on. |
| AC-2 | done | `DockWorkspace.spec` › "the happy path calls exit then terminal, and carries the measured rect" now asserts `sourceRect` equals the measured box. Without the fix it fails: "the measured box also sizes the vessel". |
| AC-3 | done | The drag-path witnesses stay green: `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` (local) and the full unit suite, including `DockVesselSize`, `DockTabSortZone` and `DockTearOut`. |
